summary: Completed testing of Points tab in My Flight page. All requested features working correctly after fixing a backend bug in participant type filtering.

fixed_issues.issue: Filter by 'cadet' participant_type returned empty results because it only matched ['student', 'cadet'] but actual data uses 'basic_student', 'advanced_student'
fixed_issues.fix: Updated filter to include basic_student, advanced_student for cadets and cadre, staff, senior_member for cadre

issues: Console warning: Missing DialogContent aria-describedby (accessibility) - non-blocking

Points tab shows Flight Standing card with rank (#1) and total points (95)
Points tab shows list of cadets assigned to flight (2 cadets in Alpha)
Each cadet shows their current point total
Merit (+) button opens modal with pre-filled values (cadet name, type=Merit, points=5)
Demerit (-) button opens modal with pre-filled values (type=Demerit, points=5)
Merit/demerit form has Type dropdown (Merit/Demerit), Points input, and Reason textarea
Submitting merit records data and shows success toast
Cadet points update after refresh (after backend fix)
Recent Activity section appears after merits are awarded
View Full Point Tracker & Leaderboards link navigates to /points
Points are connected to main point tracker (same data in backend)
